description.en: ATOM-Bench evaluates atomic skills and compositional generalization in manipulation policies across 30 atomic tasks and 24 held-out compositional tasks, using paired single-arm and dual-arm robot tracks, with 3,000 human demonstrations and evaluation rollout data released.

evidence.snippet: We introduce \textbf{ATOM-Bench}, a real-world benchmark for evaluating both atomic skills and compositional generalization in manipulation policies.

claire_radar.motivation: Generalist manipulation policies are increasingly presented as foundation models for robotic control, but their real-world generalization remains difficult to diagnose.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: ATOM-Bench provides a public diagnostic testbed for disentangling failures in motor execution, instruction grounding, and compositional reuse, which is crucial for advancing generalist manipulation policies beyond demonstrated tasks.
